import re
PARSE_RE = re.compile(r'''({{|}}|{\w*(?:(?:\.\w+)|(?:\[[^\]]+\]))*(?::[^}]+)?})''')

# Test various patterns
tests = [
    '{abc',
    'test}',
    '{{abc}',
    '{name}',
    '{{ }}',
    '{name:w}',
    '{hello.world}',
    'text {name} text',
]

for t in tests:
    parts = PARSE_RE.split(t)
    print(f'Pattern: {t!r}')
    print(f'  Parts: {parts}')
    print()
